  PMS 1.43.4.10903 GET /library/collections/{ratingKey}/children?includeGuids=1, exactly what plexapi's
  Collection.items() issues. Recorded 2026-10-02, read-only, off a real server's Movies library for custom
  seasons (issue #137), where a season may read its films from one of the owner's own Plex collections.
  A regular (non-smart) collection of 50 films, cut to its first 4 with the container's size to match.
  File paths are neutralised; every other attribute, child and value is verbatim.

  What it settles:
  - Every member carries its <Guid id="tmdb://..."> inline, so one read resolves a collection to TMDB ids
    with no per-item re-read. 50 of 50 here, and every member of 46 to 1,187-film collections on the
    same server, smart and regular alike.
  - The container carries ONLY `size`: no totalSize, no librarySectionID. Each <Video> carries its own
    librarySectionID / librarySectionKey / librarySectionTitle instead.
  - Each member lists the collections it belongs to as <Collection tag> children.
-->
